title: Collision guard compounds suffixes (X-2-3.jsonl) instead of incrementing (X-3.jsonl)
evidence:
+	var target := path
+	var n := 2
+	while FileAccess.file_exists(target):
+		target = "%s-%d.%s" % [target.get_basename(), n, target.get_extension()]
+		n += 1
detail: The loop rebases off `target`, which mutates each pass, so a 3rd same-second session becomes session-X-2-3.jsonl, not session-X-3.jsonl; the docstring promises a '-2/-3 suffix'.
recommended_fix: Rebase off the original path in the loop: use path.get_basename()/path.get_extension() instead of the mutating target.

title: age_picked and street_name hooks are never exercised or asserted by the scene test
evidence:
func _on_age_picked(bracket: String) -> void:
+	_record("age_picked", {"bracket": bracket})
 	_close_popup()
 	_age_picked.emit(bracket)
+	accept.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
+		_record("street_name", {"name": current["name"]})
+		_street_name_picked.emit(current["name"])
+	4:
+		_street._age_picked.emit("8-10")
+	5:
+		_street._street_name_picked.emit("Fresh Lane")
detail: The test drives the age/street-name flow by emitting the _age_picked/_street_name_picked signals directly rather than via the buttons, and _check_fresh_boot never asserts an age_picked or street_name event.
recommended_fix: Press the real age/street-name buttons (or call _on_age_picked) and assert events.has('age_picked') / events.has('street_name').

title: Scorecard 'First wage <60s' formula uses session-wide elapsed_ms; wrong after NEW GAME
evidence:
+| First wage <60s | first `first_wage` after the latest `boot`: `elapsed_ms` ÷ 1000 = ____ s | PASS / FAIL |
+| FIND WORK found unaided | `job_picked` present before any observer word; time from its segment's `boot` = ____ s | PASS / FAIL |
+	_start_ms = Time.get_ticks_msec()
+		"elapsed_ms": Time.get_ticks_msec() - _start_ms,
detail: _start_ms is set once in begin() and never reset on boot, so for a NEW GAME segment Row 1's elapsed_ms ÷ 1000 yields total session time (minutes), not that segment's first-wage time.
recommended_fix: Tell the observer to subtract the segment boot's elapsed_ms (Row 2 already implies this), or log a per-segment elapsed reset on each boot.
